events.subtitle: Songs and Stories — Dodge Poetry Festival
events.factual_description: NJPAC presents Patti Smith in Prudential Hall on Friday, October 16, 2026 at 8:00 PM as a special ticketed event of the 2026 Dodge Poetry Festival. NJPAC bills the New Jersey return as a night of songs and stories and identifies Smith as the 'punk poet laureate'; the festival is built around poetry as performance and social expression.

provenance.note: Date, 8:00 PM show time, Prudential Hall venue, Dodge Poetry Festival context and songs-and-stories billing were verified against NJPAC's exact event page; Ticketmaster confirms the same date/time and authorized sale. The recommended listening link is the exact Apple Music album page for Horses.

en.why_it_matters: The point is not simply that Patti Smith is important. This is Smith in the setting where the two halves of her artistic identity actually meet: a major poetry festival, in New Jersey, with a songs-and-stories format rather than a routine rock set. Her fusion of poetry, punk, literature and political-cultural presence is the program itself, which gives this date a specificity a standard tour stop would not have.
en.trip_verdict: S regional. Worth building a Newark/NYC trip around if the poetry-rock intersection matters to you: the Dodge context and songs-and-stories format make it substantially more singular than a normal Patti Smith concert. Not S+ because it is special context rather than a farewell, unique ensemble or demonstrably unrepeatable performance.

es.why_it_matters: La razón no es simplemente que Patti Smith sea importante. Aquí aparece justamente en el contexto donde se encuentran las dos mitades de su identidad artística: un gran festival de poesía, en Nueva Jersey, con un formato de canciones e historias en vez de un set rutinario de rock. Su mezcla de poesía, punk, literatura y presencia político-cultural es el propio programa, y eso le da a esta fecha una especificidad que una parada normal de gira no tendría.
es.trip_verdict: S regional. Sí vale construir una salida a Newark/NYC alrededor de esta fecha si te interesa el cruce entre poesía y rock: el contexto Dodge y el formato de canciones e historias la vuelven mucho más singular que un concierto normal de Patti Smith. No llega a S+ porque el valor excepcional viene del contexto, no de una despedida, una formación única o una actuación demostrablemente irrepetible.
